# Sample data

**Both files here are SYNTHETIC. They are not real StarRocket flights.** They were generated by
`tools/make-samples.mjs` from the built-in physics model plus seeded random noise, and each file starts with
a comment saying so. The lat/lon values in the second file are fake offsets from 0,0 and are not a real place.

| File | What it exercises |
|---|---|
| `synthetic-baro-only.csv` | Barometer only: `time_ms` + `altitude_ft`, 20 Hz, one second of pad samples. Tests ms/ft unit detection, derived velocity, derived events and the wind-drift estimate. |
| `synthetic-gps-events.csv` | `time_s`, `alt_m`, `velocity_mps`, `accel_mps2`, `lat`, `lon`, `event`, 10 Hz. Tests supplied velocity/acceleration, GPS downrange path and labelled events. |

Regenerate with `npm run samples` (deterministic: the same files come out every time).
See [../docs/CSV_FORMAT.md](../docs/CSV_FORMAT.md) for the accepted format.
